title.narrative: Project Maji Clusters in rural Kenya

description.narrative: Project Maji introduces a novel blended-financed rural water delivery model, multiplying impact and driving sector change. In a 3-year programme, they will:- Halve the price of their solar-powered water kiosks through value-engineering;- Leverage economies of scale and install 34 kiosks, transforming over 40,000 lives;- Introduce a blended finance model in which the capital investment is split 50/50 between a repayable loan and a grant;- Water revenues will pay for O&M and pay back the loan.- Reduce their donor dependency by 75% and challenge the status quo of rural water economics.

title.narrative: Please provide a short narrative explanation of the data here. (max 250 words)

actual.value: The data is collected through mWater and the Water ATMs (Susteq). For this program, we have developed a dedicated Donor Console in mWater for transparency reasons [https://go.mwater.co/pm/aquaforall](https://go.mwater.co/pm/aquaforall). All the relevant socio-economic information is available in real-time including interactive maps, pre- & post-impact socio-economic surveys, Issue reports, uptime statistics, and water sales. We engage Junior Researchers, whom we trained ourselves in a talent development program, on a contract basis. In addition, our permanent staff members are responsible for maintenance and uptime reporting.
